assets.name: bearer tokens, signing secrets, card numbers in requests

attackers.capability: authenticated user of tenant B who knows or guesses order IDs of tenant A
authenticated non-admin who calls admin endpoints directly
network observer who can capture and resend a signed refund request
attacker who forges, tampers, or re-uses expired tokens, including alg=none
authenticated user sending crafted query strings
insider or CI viewer reading logs and build artifacts

abuseCases.title: Cross-tenant order read (IDOR)
abuseCases.impact: confidential order data of another tenant disclosed
abuseCases.mitigation: tenant predicate on every query; identical 404 for missing and foreign IDs
tests: AC-01 cross-tenant read returns the same 404 as a missing order

abuseCases.title: Privilege escalation to refunds
abuseCases.mitigation: role check before any refund processing

abuseCases.title: Replay of a signed refund
abuseCases.mitigation: HMAC over method/path/timestamp/nonce/body, 60 s window, single-use nonce
tests: AC-03 replayed, stale, or tampered refund requests are rejected

abuseCases.title: Forged, tampered, expired, or alg=none token
abuseCases.mitigation: HS256 only, constant-time signature check, exp required
tests: AC-04 forged, tampered, expired, and alg=none tokens are unauthenticated

abuseCases.title: SQL injection through search
abuseCases.impact: cross-tenant data disclosure or data destruction
abuseCases.mitigation: prepared statements only; input length limit
tests: AC-05 injection payloads stay inside the caller's tenant
AC-05 control: string-built SQL leaks another tenant (oracle sanity)

abuseCases.title: Request flooding by one principal
tests: AC-06 one principal is throttled without affecting another

abuseCases.title: Secrets or card numbers in logs and artifacts
abuseCases.mitigation: structured audit events passed through redact(); secret scan of fixtures and artifacts
asvs: V16 Security Logging and Error Handling
tests: AC-07 audit log never contains tokens, signatures, or card numbers
AC-07 fixtures and test artifacts contain no secrets or real PANs

abuseCases.title: Malformed input causing 5xx or stack disclosure
abuseCases.mitigation: size limit, JSON/shape validation, generic error body with correlation ID
asvs: V16 Security Logging and Error Handling
tests: AC-08 API fuzz: malformed requests never yield 5xx or stack traces

standards.asvs: OWASP ASVS 5.0 chapter (requirement-level mapping is a follow-up once the team adopts a version)
